publishedRecipe.name: Tilapia with Cilantro-Orange Zucchini & Bell Pepper Sauté over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cup water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 red bell pepper
1 orange
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim and large dice zucchini; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle cornstarch, salt, and pepper over both sides, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb tilapia fillet
¼ cup cornstarch
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tilapia and cook, flipping once, until crispy and easily flakes with a fork, about 6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil; set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the orange juice, along with broth, soy sauce, additional cornstarch, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp soy sauce
4 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and sauté until fork-tender, 6-7 minutes.
Add sauce to the skillet with the veggies; continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce is thickened, about 1 minute.
To serve, divide rice, tilapia, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!
